summary: "Recent test work covered the edges that most often hide media bugs: redirect-based load-error redaction, multi-channel audio through SoundTouch, and rendering differences in color tests on macOS. It also adds checks for FLAC channel layouts and other tricky audio conversions, which helps keep playback, audio processing, and visuals aligned as the media stack evolves. In practical terms, this is about catching regressions before they show up in streaming, conferencing, or unusual audio files."
